card.name: Digits inside error ranges and intervals
card.fires_on: Digits in numbers that follow a ± sign or sit inside a parenthesized range, mostly in lethal-dose (LD50) tables. Also the 9 and 0 of '90% CI' confidence intervals.

modes.label: Number after ±
modes.description: The digit right after a ± sign giving a spread or standard error.

modes.label: Inside a range in parentheses
modes.description: A digit of the low end of a range given in parentheses after a value.
modes.example: given over a five minute period. The subcutaneous LD 50 of prilocaine HCl in female mice is 550 (<<3>>59 to 905)

modes.label: Confidence interval label
modes.description: The digits of '90% CI' in text about confidence intervals.
modes.example: ; OH, hydroxyl * Data for 2-OH desipramine were not plotted to enhance clarity; the fold change and 9<<0>>% CI for Cmax and AUC

card.writes: It suppresses plus-minus signs, so it tells the model that a ± is not what comes next.
card.plain: It fires on digits within a value's spread or range, such as after ± or inside a confidence interval.
